takeover.finding: MediaStudioPage.tsx and MediaStudioPage.test.tsx changes were written by the prior Codex execution during its 12:26-12:33 window; the contested-file stop was a false positive and this run was authorized to take over both files.

lateWatchdogReconciliation.finding: Two local watchdog --once processes resumed the prior task after the first code commit and added history display normalization. They were stopped before further work; the change was retained because the live delivery response carries head version 2 on both historical rows while revision remains 1 and 2.
lateWatchdogReconciliation.verification: The regression fixture now mirrors that live response and still renders first and second version labels from revision.

rootCause.finding: The external acceptance run reached an old :8080 API process whose OpenAPI did not include the R5-M04 delivery, exports, or publish-proposals routes. Restarting :8080 with current m1 restored all three routes.
rootCause.frontendHardening: Delivery read failures now render a recoverable error with an explicit reload action instead of silently becoming an empty delivery state.
